description:
• About our brand and products: We are a rapidly growing small business that started off as a cutting edge supplement in our nutrition shop and ended up taking over our entire business! The Owner of MyKanna is passionate about mental and physical health and on his search for a natural product that could effectively manage stress without added side effects. As an avid researcher in pharmacology and botanical medicine - his one issue was that every "solution" came with a myriad of side effects that also had to be managed. This is what led him to Kanna and it's incredible effects without harsh or unwanted side effects! 

• What makes us different: We are not a cookie cutter supplement that one manufacturer slaps different labels on. This company was built from the ground up by the blood sweat and tears of a young man with an obsession with the current state of mental health in our world. He realized he could only make so much of a difference on his own and believes that this company and its products are going to actually give people a chance at taking back control over their life!

 As Zac likes to say

 - "You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink...unless you give it a Kanna gummy, then he'll get out of his own way."


• How affiliates can earn: Share your unique 15% off discount code and/or affiliate link with friends, family and fans! Every sale earns you 15% commision! 


• How to promote us: We sure love the social media love but honestly, we know that truly the most important conversations are the ones you have in person. We want our affiliates to focus more on being empowering individuals throughout their communities. We know if you focus on this first - then it will only be natural that those people you inspire use the supplements you recommend to keep that mindset locked in! This is how we will truly make a difference instead of just another sale..


• Other information: Since we are a small company right now all approved affiliates will receive a Free 30 serving bag monthly and wholesale pricing on any extra units needed to succeed!

 If monthly revenue generated is over 500$ a month we will supply extra product for promos and will can open conversation on advertising investments to promote your content containing our products!
payout_period: Payouts are sent between the 15th and 20th of every month.
